# Huevos Rancheros

Fried eggs over lightly crisped corn tortillas with warm ranchero salsa and refried beans.

## 🥘 Ingredients
- [ ] 8 eggs
- [ ] 8 corn tortillas
- [ ] 2 cups ranchero salsa
- [ ] 2 cups refried beans, warmed
- [ ] 3 tbsp vegetable oil
- [ ] 1/2 tsp kosher salt
- [ ] 1/4 tsp black pepper
- [ ] 1 avocado, sliced
- [ ] 1/2 cup crumbled queso fresco
- [ ] 1/4 cup chopped cilantro

## 🍳 Instructions
1. Warm the ranchero salsa in a saucepan over low heat.
2. Heat the oil in a skillet and lightly fry each tortilla for 20 seconds per side, then drain.
3. Fry the eggs in the same skillet to the desired doneness and season with salt and pepper.
4. Spread warm refried beans on each tortilla.
5. Top each tortilla with two fried eggs and spoon salsa over the top.
6. Garnish with avocado, queso fresco, and cilantro and serve immediately.
